---
name: Feature Request
about: Describe a user problem that Forge should solve.
title: "[Feature] "
labels: feature
assignees: ''
---

### Problem

Describe the concrete workflow or limitation. Explain who encounters it and
why existing APIs are insufficient.

### Desired outcome

Describe observable behavior rather than prescribing an implementation.

### Alternatives considered

Include standard-library, upstream Kratos, and external-library alternatives
where relevant.

### Compatibility and dependencies

Identify public behavior changes, migration cost, new dependencies, generated
code changes, and minimum Go version implications.
